name: 編集部のコレクション紹介
prompt:
Create a static editorial collection introduction on an exact 390 x 180 px logical white canvas. Follow reference 1 only for the original hierarchy and spacing: publisher identity, quiet collection metadata, strong title, supporting description. Reference 2 is authoritative for the localized Japanese wording, Lighthouse mark, line layout, and crop. Reference 3 is an exact crop of that localized mark; preserve its white 灯 glyph and square proportions. Do not reproduce the Medium Me wordmark or source-English copy.

Render these exact strings:
ライトハウス編集部
2026年10月17日 ・ 8記事 ・ 108件保存
一日を心地よく始めるために
朝の時間をつくる、ヒントとアイデア。

Keep the mark 40 x 30 px at about x=24,y=14. Place the editor label to its right near x=76,y=16, with the metadata below near x=76,y=42. Put the title and description below, left-aligned at about x=24; follow the Japanese mock's vertical positions and spacing. Use the existing Japanese adaptation's Meiryo hierarchy: quiet regular publisher and metadata, bold collection title, regular supporting description. Match the mock's visible sizes and weights.

Use pure white #FFFFFF for the entire outer canvas, ink #1D1D1D for the title and main text, secondary gray #6E6E6E for metadata, and current Lighthouse Brand #1F6444 for the mark field. Keep the composition crisp, compact, and editorial.

No card, border, shadow, ambient texture, gradients, article rows, article thumbnails, status bar, navigation controls, bookmark/menu buttons, reaction pill, tab bar, Medium branding, extra text, or invented interaction. Do not paraphrase the Japanese copy.
reviewNotes: Best of two authorized attempts; exact Japanese copy and line breaks are retained. Compared with the 390x180 mock, title/body are about 10-15% too large and identity row is about 8 px low; near-white canvas samples range #FDFDFD-#FFFFFF and the mark is near #097252 rather than #1F6444. Source catalog retains sourceFidelity REVIEW_PENDING and detailedSourceComparisonPassed=false. Local candidate only; needs-correction.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
